stock.description: Based in Central, Hong Kong, abc Multiactive Limited operates as an investment holding company, primarily engaged in the development and sale of computer software. Established in 2000, the company functions as a subsidiary of Maximizer International Limited. Its operations are organized into three distinct divisions: Financial Solutions, Fintech Resources, and Overseas Property Mortgage Loan Consultancy Services. Among its core offerings is OCTOSTP, a comprehensive trading platform designed to manage both front and back-office functions for brokerage firms and the securities departments within banks. The company also provides the FinReg solution, a sophisticated risk management application that assists brokerage houses in identifying unusual trades, potential insider trading, and activities related to money laundering. Beyond its software products, abc Multiactive delivers a range of professional and support services. These include general professional assistance, maintenance services, and Fintech resource provisions such as IT professional secondment and technical support. The company additionally specializes in recruiting Fintech professionals and offers advisory services for overseas property mortgage loans. Its commercial activities also involve the distribution of computer hardware and associated products, specialized software for brokerages and bank securities divisions, non-financial solution modules, various management service solutions, and infrastructure services.
